name: nerdwright-thrifting-assistant
description: Thrifting Assistant helps you discover the hidden gems. Snap tags, marks, or a whole shelf — clothing and shoes, plus housewares, silver, art, ceramics, glass, holiday decor, tools, electronics, clocks, and books — and get color-coded BUY / MAYBE / PASS calls with live resale comps, melt value for metals, fake and repro flags, and net profit, using buy rules you can tune.
